clue.text: Machine to perform with a lot of rotating inside

indicators.note: inside tells us one piece is placed within the other

parts.note: to perform is to do

indicators.note: rotating says the word for a lot is turned round and read backwards

parts.note: a lot of means many

explanation.surface: A machine that works by having lots of parts spinning inside it.
explanation.walkthrough: 'rotating' turns the word for a lot backwards, YNAM, which 'inside' tucks into the verb; the surface's spinning machine makes 'rotating' look descriptive.
explanation.definitionFit: A dynamo is a generator, a machine turning motion into electrical current.

clue.text: One handing over money is turning up in HQ with gold

indicators.note: in places the turned word within the headquarters word

parts.note: a depot is a headquarters, as of a regiment

indicators.note: in a down clue, turning up means the word is reads from bottom to top, so backwards

parts.note: or is gold in heraldry

explanation.surface: Someone hands over cash at headquarters together with some gold.
explanation.walkthrough: 'turning up' works because this is a down clue: the little word reads from the bottom upwards. 'in' sets it inside the headquarters word; 'One handing over money' is the definition, not a piece.
explanation.definitionFit: A depositor is a person who pays money into a bank account, handing it over for safekeeping.

clue.text: Hurry up over the waves to avoid a shark

indicators.note: over places the first piece above the second in this down entry
in a down clue, up means the word for hurry is read upwards, so backwards

parts.note: to hurry is to run

indicators.note: to avoid says the letter a is kept out of the combined pieces

parts.note: the waves is a poetic name for the sea

explanation.surface: A swimmer races to get clear of the water and escape a shark.
explanation.walkthrough: 'up' reverses RUN to NUR; 'over' stacks it on SEA, and 'to avoid' drops the A, leaving NURSE.
explanation.definitionFit: The nurse shark is a species of bottom-dwelling shark found in warm coastal waters.

clue.text: Wealth denied English with introduction of cunning kind of government

indicators.note: with introduction of means a piece is introduced into the middle of the other
denied means the letter for English is refused, so removed from the word

parts.note: wealth means money
arch means sly or cunning

explanation.surface: Riches withheld from the English through the arrival of a crafty form of rule.
explanation.walkthrough: 'denied' strips the English letter, leaving MONY, and 'with introduction of' opens that up for the cunning word; 'kind of government' is the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: Monarchy is a form of rule by a single sovereign, a type of governmental system.

clue.text: Disciple to blossom admitting love vital at last

indicators.note: admitting means letting something in, so the blossom word takes the other letters inside

parts.note: to blossom is to flower
love is zero in tennis scoring, written O

indicators.note: at last picks the final letter of the word vital

explanation.surface: A disciple is told to flourish while welcoming love, which is ultimately essential.
explanation.walkthrough: 'admitting' puts O plus L (from 'at last' on vital) inside FLOWER after the F.
explanation.definitionFit: A disciple is someone who adheres to a teacher, a devotee or adherent.

clue.text: One involved in deep study

parts.note: deep study suggests intense thought, but the deep is the sea, so this is a scientist who studies the sea

explanation.definitionFit: The deep is a poetic name for the sea, and this scientist studies the sea professionally.

clue.text: Sailor left with a mark after injury

parts.note: a scar is the mark left after a wound heals

explanation.surface: A sailor departs carrying a mark from an old wound.
explanation.definitionFit: A lascar is an Indian or South-East Asian seaman, historically crewing European ships.

clue.text: Component in cereal making a light meat?

indicators.note: in tells us the component word is placed inside the cereal word

parts.note: wheat is a cereal crop
an item is a component or constituent part

explanation.surface: A part of breakfast cereal producing something light to eat.
explanation.walkthrough: 'in' signals the container. The question mark flags that 'light' means pale in colour, not low in calories.
explanation.definitionFit: White meat is poultry or veal, pale-coloured flesh as opposed to red meat.

clue.text: Recover one lost daughter in play

indicators.note: lost says the letter for one goes missing from the word

parts.note: to recover is to regain
I is the Roman numeral for one

explanation.surface: Getting back a daughter who went missing during a play.
explanation.walkthrough: REGAN is one of King Lear's daughters in Shakespeare's play.
explanation.definitionFit: Regan is one of the three daughters in Shakespeare's tragedy King Lear.

clue.text: Plant Dad gets gardener finally to cut

parts.note: pa is an informal word for dad

indicators.note: finally picks the last letter of the word gardener

parts.note: to snip is to cut with scissors

explanation.surface: Father gets the gardener at last to do some pruning of a plant.
explanation.definitionFit: The parsnip is a plant grown for its pale edible root vegetable.

clue.text: Treat the panel specially — it will present a varnished surface

definitions.text: it will present a varnished surface

indicators.note: specially suggests the letters are given special treatment, so rearranged into a new order

explanation.surface: Instructions to finish a wooden panel so that it ends up glossy.
explanation.walkthrough: 'specially' signals an anagram of TREAT THE PANEL.
explanation.definitionFit: Patent leather is leather with a glossy lacquered finish, so it shows a varnished surface.

clue.text: Having a big meal but missing the first course

indicators.note: missing the first means the opening letter of the word is dropped

parts.note: feasting is having a big meal

explanation.surface: Someone eating a huge dinner but skipping the starter.
explanation.walkthrough: 'course' looks like part of a meal, matching the surface, but it is a direction of travel.
explanation.definitionFit: An easting is a course or distance travelled eastward, a navigation term.

clue.text: Open box with key to get weapon

indicators.note: open means the box word is split apart so a letter can go in

parts.note: to box is to spar
E is a musical key

explanation.surface: Break into a container using a key to reach a weapon.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Open' splits SPAR and E goes inside.
explanation.definitionFit: A spear is a long-shafted thrusting or throwing weapon with a pointed head.

clue.text: There's change from a banknote when you get this flavouring agent

indicators.note: change suggests the letters are changed into a different order

explanation.surface: Breaking a banknote gets you some loose coins when you buy a flavouring.
explanation.walkthrough: 'change' looks like coins from a note, but it signals an anagram of A BANKNOTE.
explanation.definitionFit: The tonka bean is a seed used to flavour food and perfume, with a vanilla-like scent.

clue.text: Risky advice to make a fleeting contact

definitions.meaning: risky means precarious, uncertain in outcome

definitions.text: advice to make a fleeting contact
definitions.meaning: read literally as an instruction to brush something and leave at once

explanation.definitionFit: The phrase means precarious, and read literally it tells someone to touch briefly then leave.

clue.text: Reporting to worker in secret

parts.note: one who reports to a manager is under them
a hand is a manual worker

explanation.surface: A worker answers to a boss on the quiet.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Reporting' tempts as a homophone signal, but here 'Reporting to' is a staff hierarchy giving UNDER.
explanation.definitionFit: Done underhand means done secretly or deceitfully, out of sight.

clue.text: What business folk do? Hand out cards

definitions.meaning: business people make transactions or bargains
to distribute cards to players in a card game

explanation.definitionFit: To deal is to trade or do business, and also to distribute playing cards.

clue.text: Sally? A woman at the wedding losing her head

indicators.note: losing her head means the woman's word drops its first letter

parts.note: a bride is the woman being married at a wedding

explanation.surface: A woman named Sally at a wedding loses her composure.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Sally' looks like a woman's name but is an outing.
explanation.definitionFit: A sally is a trip or excursion, and a ride is an outing on horseback or in a vehicle.

clue.text: A new attempt after appeals for jocularity

indicators.note: after places the following pieces behind the word for appeals

parts.note: appeals means pleas
an attempt is a try

explanation.surface: Someone tries again after appeals in a bid for some humour.
explanation.definitionFit: A pleasantry is a joking remark, an instance of good-humoured jocularity.

clue.text: A key point about drug being for youngsters only?

indicators.note: about means surrounding, so the drug letter sits inside the point word

parts.note: the gist is the key point of a matter
E is slang for the drug ecstasy

explanation.surface: An important point about a drug being suitable only for the young.
explanation.walkthrough: 'about' puts E inside GIST, after A. The question mark flags a cryptic definition: favouring the young is discrimination by age.
explanation.definitionFit: Ageism means discriminating by age, so a youth-only policy is discriminatory in that way.

clue.text: Newspaper brought in standard essayist to provide short item

indicators.note: brought in means the newspaper word is placed inside the standard word

parts.note: par is a standard or norm
a rag is a disparaging word for a newspaper
A. P. Herbert, humorist and essayist, was known by his initials

explanation.surface: A newspaper takes on a top-standard essayist to supply a brief piece.
explanation.walkthrough: 'brought in' signals the container. APH are the initials of A. P. Herbert, the English humorist and essayist, who signed his pieces that way.
explanation.definitionFit: A paragraph is a short news item in a newspaper, a brief report.

clue.text: Course of Italian history ending in Abyssinia

parts.note: history is the past

indicators.note: ending in picks the final letter of the word Abyssinia

explanation.surface: A course on Italian history covers its finale in Abyssinia.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Course' suggests study, but it is a dish in an Italian meal.
explanation.definitionFit: Pasta is a dish served as a course in an Italian meal.

clue.text: Chapel — it refuses to offer a quantity of drink

indicators.note: to offer means the run of letters across these words is presented within them

explanation.surface: A chapel refuses to serve any alcohol.
explanation.walkthrough: 'to offer' signals the letters shown inside chapeL IT REfuses.
explanation.definitionFit: A litre is a metric unit of volume, a measured amount of liquid.

clue.text: Judge carrying little weight when meeting king

parts.note: someone carrying little weight is thin
K is the abbreviation for king in chess

explanation.surface: A slim judge meets the monarch.
explanation.definitionFit: To think is to judge or consider, as in forming an opinion.

clue.text: Foreign language — to get the full extent is hard

parts.note: a span is the full extent of something
H is the pencil abbreviation for hard

explanation.surface: Mastering a foreign tongue fully is difficult.
explanation.definitionFit: Spanish is a language spoken in Spain and Latin America, foreign to English speakers.

clue.text: Fixes displays giving material a frontal position

indicators.note: a frontal position puts the material word at the front, before the displays word

parts.note: rep is a ribbed fabric
to air is to display openly

explanation.surface: Fixes shows giving a fabric the front spot.
explanation.definitionFit: Repairs are mends or fixes made to broken things.

clue.text: Get diary out to arrange for hearing

indicators.note: to arrange means the letters are put into a new order

explanation.surface: Fetch your diary to set a date for a court hearing.
explanation.walkthrough: 'hearing' suggests a court session, but the definition means relating to the sense of hearing.
explanation.definitionFit: Auditory means relating to hearing or the ears, the sense of sound.

clue.text: All right to carry around gun no longer working?

indicators.note: to carry around means the gun word encloses the other piece

parts.note: the Bren is a British light machine gun
OK means all right

explanation.surface: Is it all right to carry a gun that does not work any more?
explanation.definitionFit: Something broken is out of order, damaged so it fails to function.
